mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_mail_send_job ( document_srl, send_type, trigger_type, template_id, mail_subject_snapshot, mail_body_snapshot, attachment_type, recipient_count, excluded_count, blacklist_excluded_count, send_status, scheduled_at, sent_at, threshold_snapshot, target_snapshot_count, duplicate_prevent_key, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{documentSrl}, #{sendType}, #{triggerType}, #{templateId}, #{mailSubjectSnapshot}, #{mailBodySnapshot}, #{attachmentType}, #{recipientCount}, #{excludedCount}, #{blacklistExcludedCount}, #{sendStatus}, #{scheduledAt}, #{sentAt}, #{thresholdSnapshot}, #{targetSnapshotCount}, #{duplicatePreventKey}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT job.*, template.template_name FROM admin_mail_send_job job LEFT JOIN admin_mail_template template ON template.id = job.template_id WHERE job.duplicate_prevent_key = #{duplicatePreventKey} ORDER BY job.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT job.*, template.template_name FROM admin_mail_send_job job LEFT JOIN admin_mail_template template ON template.id = job.template_id WHERE job.id = #{id}

SELECT job.*, template.template_name FROM admin_mail_send_job job LEFT JOIN admin_mail_template template ON template.id = job.template_id ORDER BY COALESCE(job.sent_at, job.scheduled_at, job.created_at) DESC, job.id DESC

SELECT job.*, template.template_name FROM admin_mail_send_job job LEFT JOIN admin_mail_template template ON template.id = job.template_id ORDER BY COALESCE(job.sent_at, job.scheduled_at, job.created_at) DESC, job.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT MAX(COALESCE(sent_at, scheduled_at, created_at)) FROM admin_mail_send_job

SELECT job.*, template.template_name FROM admin_mail_send_job job LEFT JOIN admin_mail_template template ON template.id = job.template_id WHERE job.document_srl = #{documentSrl} ORDER BY COALESCE(job.sent_at, job.scheduled_at, job.created_at) DESC, job.id DESC

SELECT job.*, template.template_name FROM admin_mail_send_job job LEFT JOIN admin_mail_template template ON template.id = job.template_id WHERE job.send_status = 'SCHEDULED' AND job.scheduled_at IS NOT NULL AND job.scheduled_at <= #{scheduledAt} ORDER BY job.scheduled_at ASC, job.id ASC
